definitions.gloss: genuine; authentic; official (of products or parts)
definitions.explanation: Describes products made by the original manufacturer, as opposed to third-party or counterfeit items.
Describes something that is free from impurities or foreign elements.

examples.japanese: {純正|じゅんせい}{品|ひん}を{使|つか}ってください。
このインクは{純正|じゅんせい}ですか。
examples.english: Is this ink an official product?

examples.japanese: {純正|じゅんせい}{部品|ぶひん}は{高|たか}いが、{互換|ごかん}{品|ひん}より{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Genuine parts are expensive, but they last longer than compatible alternatives.

examples.japanese: {純正|じゅんせい}な{律|りつ}で{調律|ちょうりつ}する。
{純正|じゅんせい}{律|りつ}と{平均|へいきん}{律|りつ}の{違|ちが}いを{聞|き}き{分|わ}けるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to hear the difference between just intonation and equal temperament.

examples.japanese: この{蜂蜜|はちみつ}は{純正|じゅんせい}で、{混|ま}ぜ{物|もの}は{一切|いっさい}{入|はい}っていない。
examples.english: This honey is pure, with no additives whatsoever.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in consumer contexts (sense 1) when discussing whether a product is the original manufacturer's or a third-party alternative. Functions as a の-adjective when modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純正|じゅんせい}{品|ひん}: genuine product/part
- {純正|じゅんせい}{部品|ぶひん}: genuine parts
- {純正|じゅんせい}アクセサリー: official accessories
- {純正|じゅんせい}{律|りつ}: just intonation (music)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正規|せいき}{品|ひん}: authorized product (focuses on the sales channel)
- {純粋|じゅんすい}な: pure (more for abstract purity — feelings, intentions)
- {本物|ほんもの}: the real thing (more colloquial)
